blocker.why_not_switched: Upstream's version-cohort admission lets one build run per account. Switching bin/codebase-memory-mcp to 0.12.1 now makes every new Claude or Codex session's MCP server exit rc=1 (conflict with the live 0.11.0 daemon) and lose the codebase-memory tools until the last 0.11.0 session closes. The sweep task's rule: a smoke that fails in place keeps the old link.

switch_when_ready.precondition: no codebase-memory process is running: test -z "$(pgrep -l codebase-memory)"   (all 0.11.0 sessions closed, so the daemon has retired; or the CC retires it with 'codebase-memory-mcp daemon stop' once no session uses it)
switch_when_ready.after_switch_cost: the first index of each project is a full rebuild; run it deliberately under idle priority, for example: systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUWeight=idle "$ECO/bin/codebase-memory-mcp" cli index_repository --repo-path <repo>   (then cross-repo linking must be re-run for linked projects)

rollback: ln -s "$ECO/tools/codebase-memory-mcp-0.11.0/codebase-memory-mcp" "$ECO/bin/.codebase-memory-mcp.new" && mv -T "$ECO/bin/.codebase-memory-mcp.new" "$ECO/bin/codebase-memory-mcp"; tools/codebase-memory-mcp-0.11.0 is kept (live processes run from it). An index rebuilt by 0.12.1 (format 2) is not guaranteed readable by 0.11.0; keep copies of the .db files before the first 0.12.1 index if a rollback must stay possible.
